candidates.sentence: She is fighting to bring jobs home, take away tax breaks from companies that ship jobs overseas, and for tariffs that protect Ohio-based factories and companies.
She has fought to protect Social Security and Medicare from cuts and privatization, because working people have spent years paying into the system and they deserve to be covered.
Marcy believes in secure borders and legal immigration.
Just as the answer is not separating children from parents at the border, Marcy knows an orderly approach that prioritizes the security of the United States must be put in place.
Marcy opposes a national abortion ban, especially a ban that would not make exceptions for rape, incest or life of the mother.
Marcy Kaptur knows we must reign in special interests and has supported legislation to repeal Citizens United, to limit spending in elections, and to improve access to the ballot for candidates.
